Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Annotation Interface PostgresIT

@Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @SpringBootTest @ActiveProfiles("test") @Import({PostgresTestConfiguration.class,KeyEncryptionTestConfiguration.class}) public @interface PostgresIT
Meta-annotation for integration tests backed by a PostgreSQL Testcontainers container. Annotating an *IT class with it starts a Spring Boot test context wired to the container, with the test profile active (it selects test-only adapters, such as the logging SMS sender of auth-server, which a deployment never gets by default). A test class that declares @ActiveProfiles itself replaces it.
